definitions.explanation: In baseball, a statistic measuring a batter's performance calculated by dividing the number of hits by the number of at-bats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{今|こん}→今〜：03952_kon⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打率|だりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えている→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: His batting average this season is over .300.

examples.japanese: {打率|だりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がって→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦スランプ→スランプ：29125_suranpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: His batting average dropped and he fell into a slump.

examples.japanese: ⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{打率|だりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}→首位打者：26604_shuidasha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The player with the highest batting average in the league becomes the batting champion.
